topologies.label: Centralized counter
topologies.detail: Every gateway spends one authoritative budget before admitting a request.
topologies.healthyGuarantee: Strong global enforcement while the counter service is reachable.
topologies.partitionBehavior: A disconnected region must bypass the check or stop admitting protected traffic.

topologies.label: Local counters
topologies.detail: Each region enforces a full independent copy of the nominal limit.
topologies.healthyGuarantee: Low-latency regional admission with no per-request shared dependency.
topologies.partitionBehavior: Admission continues, but the same identity can spend one full budget in every region.

topologies.label: Leased regional budgets
topologies.detail: A coordinator divides the global budget into bounded regional leases.
topologies.healthyGuarantee: Fast regional admission while lease allocation bounds global overshoot.
topologies.partitionBehavior: A disconnected region can spend its remaining lease; behavior after exhaustion follows the failure policy.
